examples.english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.
“Lo, my Lord, this is the solution of the word.”

examples.english: Therefore are my loins filled with feebleness, and pangs have seized me as a travailing woman: I dealt wrongfully that I might not hear; I hasted that I might not see.

examples.english: Concerning that hour wherein He shall destroy all created things, when everything shall be overthrown, concerning that last hour, I say, and the destruction of the heavens and the earth, no one whatsoever shall know, not even the angels in the heavens, except Himself and His beloved Son, even as we have said before.
examples.source: On the End of the World and on Temple of Solomon
